results.description: Introducing NESTLÉ CERELAC Biscuits — a delicious snack specially crafted for toddlers aged 1 year and up. With their light, buttery flavour and easy-to-chew texture, these fun-shaped biscuits are designed to satisfy little taste buds while supporting self-feeding and soothing teething discomfort. Thoughtfully designed for tiny hands and mouths, CERELAC Biscuits encourage independent eating, helping toddlers develop important motor skills and making snack time both fun and beneficial. At CERELAC, we know how important wholesome nutrition is for growing toddlers. That’s why CERELAC Biscuits are baked with quality grains and contain no artificial colours, flavours, or sweeteners. You can feel confident knowing you're giving your child a snack that’s not only tasty but also made with ingredients you can trust. Busy parents will also love the on-the-go convenience of CERELAC Biscuits. Whether you're heading to the park, running errands, or taking a road trip, these snacks are easy to pop into a diaper bag, purse, or stroller pocket. For safety purposes, this product should only be fed to seated, supervised children who are accustomed to solid foods. For best storage results, keep unopened or tightly reclosed packs in a cool, dry place. Once opened, be sure to use the product within 14 days or by the best before date — whichever comes first.  With CERELAC Fingers, snack time is fun — wherever life takes you and your little one.
results.name: Cerelac Biscuits, Light Buttery Flavour, Age 1 Year & Up
